meaning:
1) council, counsel, assembly
1a) council (of familiar conversation)
1a1) divan, circle (of familiar friends)
1a2) assembly, company
1b) counsel
1b1) counsel (itself)
1b2) secret counsel
1b3) familiar converse, intimacy (with God)

renderings.kjv: they shall not be in the assembly

elsewhere.note: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung…
Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.
Therefore I am full of Yahweh’s wrath. I am weary with holding it in. “Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the assembly of young men together…
“My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be…
Surely the Lord Yahweh will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.
